name: PDF In-Place Instruction Updater
description: Edits an existing PDF from natural-language change instructions: page-wise PyMuPDF text extraction (analysis only), Azure OpenAI exact old→new substring patches, overlay application on the original PDF so images/layout/vectors are preserved. Deterministic replacements only — no rebuild, no paraphrasing, no from-scratch document authoring.

tools.name: extract_pdf_pages
tools.description: PyMuPDF page-wise text extraction for analysis only.

tools.name: generate_update_patch
tools.description: Azure OpenAI JSON patch list of exact old→new replacements.

tools.name: apply_updates_inplace
tools.description: Overlay-mask apply of patches on the original PDF.

statefulness: DocumentGenerationRunner.run is stateless per call; Azure client is created inside generate_update_patch.
